teams.design_spec: White home jersey, forest-green raglan sleeves, gold piping, small green five-point chest star. Forest-green cap with matching five-point star, gold for visibility. Coaches retain original garment construction in green/gold.

White home jersey, purple shoulder blocks, fine silver pinstripes, purple shield-outline chest emblem. Purple cap with small silver shield outline. Coaches retain original garment construction in purple/silver.

rendering_method: Wardrobe-only image_gen reference edits of original portraits. Whole atlas resampling/cell packing only; no face replacement, face warp, face/body paste or facial enhancement.
source_notes: v13 original manifest names 256 files absent from source Git tree. Available original 128 RGB cells used for identity reference and unchanged framing. Runtime output sizes are 128 and 256; do not describe original reference as native256.
